description.zh:
订购的周期数量
- PricingCycle=year时，取值1-3；
- PricingCycle=month时，取值1-9。
description.en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:
- If PricingCycle is set to year, the value ranges from 1 to 3.
- If PricingCycle is set to month, the value ranges from 1 to 9.

description.zh:
实例的计费类型，返回值：

- **Prepaid**：包年包月。
- **Postpaid**：按量付费。
description.en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- **Prepaid**: subscription.
- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.

description.zh:
订购的周期单位
- year：年，
- month：月。
description.en:
The unit of the subscription period. Valid values:
- year: year.
- month: month.

descriptions.zh: 注意：payType为Postpaid时才可以调用此接口
descriptions.en: Note: This operation can be called only when payType is set to Postpaid.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase convert-instance --cluster-id hb-bp16o0pd52e3y0000 --pricing-cycle month --duration 7 --pay-type Prepaid --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbase ConvertInstance --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId 'hb-bp16o0pd52e3y0000' --PricingCycle month --Duration 7 --PayType Prepaid
